_readme: One line per registered operator: the WEAK TEST it catches. This is the single fact the
registry cannot supply — name, tier, version, target kinds and a verified example all come from
the operator object itself, and only the 'why a reader should care' is prose.
scripts/operator-tables.ts REFUSES to generate when a registered operator has no entry here, so
adding an operator without saying what it is for fails the check rather than emitting a blank
cell. Keys are operator names verbatim, including the 'lethal.' prefix.

blurbs.lethal.conditional-boundary: an off-by-one at a boundary no test pins
blurbs.lethal.negate-conditional: a branch that is taken but never checked
blurbs.lethal.remove-not: a negated guard whose two branches nobody tells apart
blurbs.lethal.void-method-call: a call whose effect nothing observes
blurbs.lethal.return-value: a return value the caller never asserts
blurbs.lethal.empty-block: a whole body nothing depends on
blurbs.lethal.swap-call-arguments: two same-typed arguments passed in the wrong order
blurbs.lethal.remove-setrange: tests that never verify the filter
blurbs.lethal.remove-calcfields: no assertion on a computed FlowField
blurbs.lethal.swap-modify-flag: trigger execution that no test checks
blurbs.lethal.swap-find-direction: a suite whose fixture only ever holds one row
blurbs.lethal.validate-to-assign: the field value asserted, the `OnValidate` side effect not
blurbs.lethal.flip-filter-literal: a filter string BC re-parses at run time, never asserted
blurbs.lethal.swap-enum-member: a state machine whose resulting state nothing asserts
blurbs.lethal.swap-additive: a sum or difference whose value no test checks
blurbs.lethal.negate-guard: a plain `if Rec.Get(...) then` guard nobody tests the other side of
blurbs.lethal.flip-boolean-literal: a flag nobody checks the other setting of
blurbs.lethal.remove-assignment: a value written that nothing downstream depends on
